content:
[L] high | main chat area | first customer message is clipped mid-line ("Hi Kim — I'm on it. Can you open the export screen and…") and its bottom edge is cut off by the Conversation card below it, with the message text colliding with the card's top border
[S] high | chat column, under "Kim One Customer" row | timestamp row and message bubble are sliced off horizontally with text fragments ("n i … u l") truncated at the left edge of the Conversation card
[L] high | chat transcript | message content runs beneath/behind the "Conversation" status card — the transcript is not respecting the card's bounds and both render on top of each other
[C] high | bottom half of window | roughly 40% of the screen is empty black dead space below the UI, making the app look unfinished/debug-build
[C] high | right side of chat panel | entire right half of the conversation area is empty dead whitespace while metadata, transcript, and controls are all crushed into the left ~400px column
[C] high | chat area | internal debug/dev notes ("customer 7 not in the mirror yet", "the message id is generated here — a retry can never double-send") are rendered as product UI text
[S] med | header area | "View:" label is cramped against the left window edge and nearly touching the "Open chats" pill, while the header text above has different insets
[H] med | conversation card | "open" status chip and "no agent is assigned — sending accepts this chat automatically" note sit directly under the "Conversation" heading with no grouping logic — heading, chip, and sentence all at similar visual weight, unclear what is a label vs message
[S] med | chat column | "End chat" red button floats unanchored with uneven spacing — large gap above it from the Conversation card and cramped gap below to the reply box
[C] med | "Conversation" card | card width is arbitrary (~400px), inconsistent with the reply box width and the transcript width — three different right edges in one panel
[H] med | chat header | "state: open · mailbox #3 · last event 2026-02-16 09:41" renders raw key:value debug metadata at equal weight with the chat title directly above it
[H] low | left list | "Chats" panel heading is same size/weight as body text, giving it no hierarchy over the list item below
[S] low | list item | customer preview text is truncated with ellipsis very close to the card edge, tighter inset than the name/timestamp row above it
[C] low | left sidebar | single list item in a tall empty panel — unbalanced dead zone below the chat card
[H] low | reply footer | "the message id is generated here…" and "type a reply to send" sit at opposite extremes of a wide row with no visual connection, reading as stray footnotes

VERDICT: unprofessional — overlapping transcript content, truncated messages, dev-facing debug strings in the UI, and a half-black window make this look like an unfinished internal tool, not shippable software.
